definitions.description: Clear Traditional Fedora package metadata and verify repository health.
definitions.recovery_guidance: The package manager rebuilds metadata on the next repository query.
definitions.title: Clean package metadata cache

definitions.description: Issue discard for mounted filesystems only after discard support is verified.
definitions.recovery_guidance: Discard is not reversible; review storage health if the command reports errors.
definitions.title: Trim supported filesystems

definitions.description: Restart one exact unit selected from a fresh failed-service query.
definitions.recovery_guidance: Inspect the unit journal and stop the service if restarting introduces a regression.
definitions.title: Restart a failed service
